transactions.desc: The Giants recalled Sanmartin from Triple-A Sacramento on Thursday.
The Phillies designated Keller for assignment Wednesday, Robert Murray of FanSided.com reports.
The Tampa Bay Rays traded C Logan Driscoll to the Miami Marlins.
The Cubs claimed Arias off waivers from the Mets on Wednesday.
The Mariners optioned Simpson to Triple-A Tacoma on Wednesday, Shannon Drayer of SeattleSports.com reports.
The Mariners selected Diaz's contract from Triple-A Tacoma on Wednesday.
The Dodgers designated Hernandez for assignment Wednesday.
The Dodgers reinstated Stewart (shoulder) from the injured list Wednesday.
The Rockies reinstated  Hill (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Rockies designated Mushinski for assignment Wednesday.
The Rockies selected Manfredi's contract from Triple-A Albuquerque on Wednesday.
The Rockies optioned Shook to Triple-A Albuquerque on Wednesday.
The Nationals selected Tolman's contract from Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
The Giants optioned Sanmartin to Triple-A Sacramento on Wednesday.
The Giants claimed Abner off waivers from the Diamondbacks on Wednesday and optioned him to Triple-A Sacramento.
The Nationals optioned Cruz to Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
The Orioles optioned Jackson to Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday, Matt Weyrich of The Baltimore Sun reports.
The Orioles activated Basallo (shoulder) from the 10-day injured list, Matt Weyrich of The Baltimore Sun reports. He'll start at first base and bat cleanup in Wednesday's game against the Yankees.
The Giants selected Wilkinson's contract from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday in Cleveland, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
The Blue Jays selected Cellucci's contract from Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday.
The Astros selected Pecko's contract from Triple-A Sugar Land on Wednesday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The Astros optioned Ullola to Triple-A Sugar Land on Wednesday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
The New York Yankees traded INF Christian Bethancourt to the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Brewers optioned Lockridge to Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday.
The Brewers activated Pratt (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list. He'll start at shortstop and bat ninth Wednesday against the Mariners.
The Guardians recalled Fry from Triple-A Columbus on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays designated Waldron for assignment Wednesday.
The Athletics optioned Johnson to Triple-A Las Vegas on Wednesday.
The Athletics reinstated Springs (hip) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Pirates acquired Bethancourt from the Yankees on Wednesday in exchange for cash considerations.
